description: Source code for a utility that modifies headers in firmware images, specifically fixing U-Media headers by updating CRCs and setting specific fields based on command-line options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line arguments and initiates header fixing.

methods.name: fix_header
methods.description: Reads the input file, verifies and updates the U-Media header, recalculates CRC, and writes back.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: str2u32
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a uint32_t value.

methods.name: str2u8
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a uint8_t value.

methods.name: read_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file contents into a buffer.

methods.name: write_fw
methods.description: Writes data to the output firmware file.
